newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador June CPI rose 0.39 pct -gov't.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador June CPI rose 0.39 pct -gov't.

text.p: El Salvador's consumer price index for June rose 0.39 percent, compared with 0.23 percent in May, the Economic Ministry said on Thursday.
Inflation rose an accumulated 2.59 percent for the year, less than the 5.03 percent registered in the same period in 1996, it said.
"The slight rise in the Consumer Price Index is in accordance to the seasonal agricultural production," statistics director Francisco Aleman said in a report.
